CANONICAL_NAME.value: Linux TCP congestion control -- CUBIC and BBR (the congestion-avoidance lineage under pressure)

value.lineage: TCP congestion control (1988-, Van Jacobson onward): Tahoe -> Reno -> NewReno -> CUBIC (2008, loss-based, the Linux default) -> BBR (2016, Google, model-based rate/RTT). Each redesign was forced by a changed network: higher bandwidth-delay products, then bufferbloat. Preserved here as the actual Linux kernel modules tcp_cubic.c and tcp_bbr.c.

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: congestion avoidance on a shared network

value.built_to: regulate a TCP sender's transmission rate so it uses available bandwidth without collapsing the shared network -- inferring congestion from loss (CUBIC) or from a bandwidth/RTT model (BBR)
value.pressure: a shared link of unknown, varying capacity with many competing senders; too fast causes loss and congestion collapse, too slow wastes the link
value.success_means: high throughput, low queueing delay, and fairness to other flows across a range of bandwidth-delay products and loss rates

value.pressure: bandwidth scarcity, packet loss, variable RTT, bufferbloat, competing flows
value.failure_condition: congestion collapse (1986): everyone retransmits into a saturated link and useful throughput drops toward zero

organs.human_interpretation: grow the congestion window as a cubic function of time since the last loss, so growth is fast far from the last maximum and flat near it, independent of RTT
organs.mechanism: a per-connection block (struct bictcp, 86-105) updated from three kernel callbacks: cong_avoid (per ACK, grows cwnd), ssthresh (on loss, shrinks and remembers), acked (per RTT sample, slow-start exit); the subsystem below is the set of mechanisms those callbacks are made of
organs.input: ACK count, current cwnd, jiffies, RTT samples, loss events (from kernel core)
assumptions: loss is the congestion signal
cwnd < 1M packets (overflow note 262-264)

organs.human_name: the cubic function W(t) = C(t-K)^3 + Wmax
organs.human_interpretation: window growth that is concave up to the old maximum and convex beyond it
organs.mechanism: at the start of an epoch (first call after a loss) record origin = Wmax and K = cbrt((Wmax - cwnd) * cube_factor); every jiffy compute t = time since epoch + delay_min, target = origin +/- c*(t-K)^3/rtt; convert the target into cnt = cwnd / (target - cwnd) ACKs per increment (or 100*cwnd if at/above target); clamp the first epoch to cnt<=20 and every epoch to cnt>=2
organs.update: at most once per jiffy (223-228); epoch restarts when epoch_start==0 (set by ssthresh)
assumptions: time, not ACK clock, drives growth (RTT-fairness by design)
fixed-point cube root (cubic_root 167-212) is exact enough
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: fast recovery of lost throughput on high-BDP paths plus a plateau at the last known ceiling
organs.failure_landscape: UNKNOWN -- not run; the code's own note: overflow above 1M packets
organs.source_boundary: bictcp_update up to the tcp_friendliness label

organs.human_name: Wmax memory / fast convergence / multiplicative decrease
organs.human_interpretation: on loss, cut the window to beta*cwnd and remember where the loss happened; if the loss came BELOW the previous remembered maximum, remember a point below the current one so a newer flow can claim share
organs.mechanism: ssthresh callback: epoch_start=0 (forces a new epoch); if cwnd < last_max_cwnd and fast_convergence then last_max_cwnd = cwnd*(1+beta)/2 else last_max_cwnd = cwnd; return max(cwnd*beta/1024, 2) with beta=717
assumptions: a loss below the last max means the bottleneck shrank or a competitor arrived

organs.human_interpretation: never grow slower than standard TCP would
organs.mechanism: a second window (tcp_cwnd) is advanced by one for every cwnd*3*(1-beta)/(1+beta)... ACKs (delta = cwnd*beta_scale>>3, 300-306) in parallel with the cubic target; if the shadow window is ahead of the real one, cap cnt at cwnd/(tcp_cwnd - cwnd) so the real window catches up at the shadow's rate
assumptions: the AIMD rate formula in the paper is what the shadow implements
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: fairness against Reno flows on low-BDP paths where the cubic function is slower than AIMD

organs.mechanism: every valid RTT sample (rtt_us >= 0, not within 1 s after a loss epoch start) lowers delay_min if smaller; delay_min is never raised except by reset on TCP_CA_Loss; delay_min is added to t in the cubic function and is the baseline for both HyStart detectors
assumptions: the smallest RTT ever seen is the propagation delay
organs.failure_landscape: UNKNOWN by run; by reading: a route change to a longer path is never learned until a loss resets (contrast bbr.windowed_minimum_of_rtt which expires after 10 s)

organs.human_interpretation: leave exponential growth before the first loss, when the path shows signs of queueing
organs.mechanism: two detectors OR'd per RTT round, active only in slow start and above cwnd 16: (train) if consecutive ACKs arrive within 2 ms of each other and the train has lasted longer than delay_min (+ a TSO cushion, halved without pacing) since round start, found=1; (delay) the minimum of the first 8+ RTT samples in the round exceeds delay_min + clamp(delay_min/8, 4 ms, 16 ms), found=1; either sets ssthresh = cwnd, which ends slow start in the kernel core
organs.input: ACK arrival times, RTT samples, delay_min, cwnd, snd_una vs end_seq (round boundary)
organs.state: round_start, end_seq, last_ack, curr_rtt, sample_cnt, found
organs.update: per ACK; round reset when snd_una passes end_seq
assumptions: ACK spacing reflects bottleneck spacing (defeated by ACK compression/aggregation, hence hystart_ack_delay 375-384)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: fewer slow-start overshoot losses on large-BDP paths
organs.failure_landscape: UNKNOWN by run; by reading: pacing and TSO change the ACK train timing (the two cushions 375-384, 405-407 are patches for that)

organs.human_interpretation: pace at the estimated bottleneck bandwidth and keep inflight near bandwidth*min_rtt, instead of reacting to loss
organs.mechanism: one callback per ACK (bbr_main 1026-1035): update a model from the kernel's rate_sample (bw filter, ack aggregation, gain cycle, startup plateau, drain, min_rtt/probe_rtt, gains), then set pacing rate = bw*pacing_gain and cwnd from bw*min_rtt*cwnd_gain
organs.input: rate_sample {delivered, interval_us, rtt_us, losses, is_app_limited, prior_in_flight, acked_sacked, is_ack_delayed}
assumptions: delivery rate and RTT samples exist (kernel rate sampling, 2016+)
the sender can pace
dependencies: kernel: tcp_rate sampling, sk_pacing_rate, lib/win_minmax.c, tcp_packets_in_flight
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: Google's production sender (record ANCESTRY); throughput under bufferbloat and policers

organs.mechanism: per ACK, bw = delivered/interval_us from the rate sample; samples flagged app-limited are dropped unless they exceed the current max; the max over the last 10 packet-timed rounds is kept by a 3-slot windowed min/max filter (kernel lib, not in the body); round boundaries are detected by prior_delivered passing next_rtt_delivered
organs.state: struct minmax bw (3 samples), rtt_cnt, next_rtt_delivered, round_start
organs.update: per ACK; window advances per round
assumptions: the largest recent delivery rate is the bottleneck rate
the window (10 rounds) is longer than the gain cycle (8 phases) so the probe's high sample survives
dependencies: lib/win_minmax.c minmax_running_max -- NOT in the fossil
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the numerator of everything: pacing rate and BDP
organs.failure_landscape: UNKNOWN by run; by reading: an ack-aggregated sample can exceed the true rate (hence the extra_acked organ)

organs.mechanism: min_rtt_us takes any smaller RTT sample; if 10 s pass with no new minimum the filter is 'expired' and (a) the next non-delayed sample replaces it, (b) the mode switches to PROBE_RTT: cwnd is forced down to 4 packets until inflight <= 4, then held for 200 ms plus one round, then the saved cwnd is restored and the mode reset (STARTUP if not full, else PROBE_BW)
organs.output: min_rtt_us; mode changes; cwnd clamp to 4
organs.state: min_rtt_us, min_rtt_stamp, probe_rtt_done_stamp, probe_rtt_round_done, prior_cwnd, idle_restart
organs.update: per ACK; a 10 s timer implemented by timestamps
assumptions: draining one's own queue for 200 ms reveals the propagation delay
all BBR flows on a path will synchronise their probes (the same 10 s / 200 ms constants)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the RTT term of the BDP; also the only mechanism that lowers inflight without a loss

organs.human_name: STARTUP / DRAIN / PROBE_BW / PROBE_RTT state machine
organs.mechanism: STARTUP paces at gain 2.885 until the max_bw filter fails to grow by 25% for 3 consecutive rounds (full_bw, full_bw_cnt); then DRAIN at gain 1/2.885 until inflight <= BDP; then PROBE_BW (gain cycle); PROBE_RTT is entered from any mode by the min_rtt organ and returns to STARTUP or PROBE_BW by full_bw_reached; each mode fixes (pacing_gain, cwnd_gain)
organs.input: bbr_max_bw over rounds, inflight, round_start, app_limited flag
organs.output: mode; pacing_gain; cwnd_gain; snd_ssthresh on entering DRAIN
organs.update: per ACK, mode transitions at round boundaries
assumptions: a rate that stops growing at 2.885x pacing means the pipe is full (not a policer, not app-limited)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: startup without a loss; the transitions are where BBR's throughput/latency trade-off lives

organs.mechanism: pacing_gain steps through [5/4, 3/4, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]; a phase lasts at least one min_rtt of wall time; the 5/4 phase persists until inflight reaches 5/4*BDP or a loss occurs; the 3/4 phase ends early once inflight <= BDP; the starting phase index is randomised (bbr_cycle_rand=7, 616-623) so flows do not synchronise
organs.update: per ACK check; advance at phase end
assumptions: briefly overshooting then undershooting the estimated BDP measures spare capacity and yields to newcomers

organs.human_interpretation: detect a token-bucket policer and pace at its long-term rate instead of cycling into it
organs.mechanism: sampling starts at the first loss; an interval must span 4-16 rounds, end on a loss, and show loss rate >= 20% (50/256); the interval's delivered/elapsed is compared with the previous interval's: if within 1/8 or 4 kbps, lt_use_bw=1 and pacing_gain is pinned to 1.0 at lt_bw for up to 48 rounds, after which sampling resets and the gain cycle restarts; app-limited samples abort the interval
organs.input: tp->lost, tp->delivered, delivered_mstamp, rs->losses, is_app_limited, round_start
organs.output: lt_bw, lt_use_bw (which overrides bbr_bw and the cycle gain)
organs.state: lt_is_sampling, lt_rtt_cnt, lt_use_bw, lt_bw, lt_last_delivered, lt_last_stamp, lt_last_lost
assumptions: a policer reveals itself as periodic loss bursts at a steady rate; two agreeing intervals are enough
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: throughput on policed paths (Google's stated motivation in the comments 685-686)

organs.mechanism: within an epoch, expected_acked = bw * elapsed; the running sum of acked packets minus expected is the excess; the epoch resets when the sum falls to or below expected; the max excess is kept in a 2-slot window that rotates every 5 rounds; the value (clamped to cwnd and to bw*100 ms) is added to the cwnd target
assumptions: ACKs arrive in batches (wifi, cellular) so cwnd must cover the silence between batches

organs.mechanism: target = bw * min_rtt * cwnd_gain (bdp 359-392, with a fallback to the initial window when min_rtt is unknown) + extra_acked + a quantization budget (3 TSO segments, +2 in the 3/4 phase); if the pipe is full, cwnd = min(cwnd + acked, target) else cwnd grows by acked until target; floor 4; on entering loss recovery cwnd = inflight + acked (packet conservation) and on leaving it the prior cwnd is restored; in PROBE_RTT the result is clamped to 4
organs.input: bw, min_rtt, cwnd_gain, acked, losses, CA state, prior_cwnd
assumptions: the kernel enforces cwnd; this organ only chooses it
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: bounds inflight so the pacing organ cannot fill a buffer alone

organs.mechanism: rate = bw * pacing_gain * (100 - 1)% in bytes/s (244-264); the first rate before any RTT sample comes from the initial cwnd / first srtt (266-283); the rate only moves DOWN before the pipe is full unless it is higher than the current one (295-300)
assumptions: the kernel's pacing (fq or internal) honours the rate
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the primary actuator: BBR is rate-based, cwnd is the backstop

pressures.condition: many senders share a link whose only feedback is a dropped packet, observed one round trip late; over-sending collapses everyone's useful throughput
pressures.resource_or_constraint: bottleneck capacity; one RTT of delay before any signal
pressures.world_punishes: sending more than the link drains for longer than the buffer hides
pressures.world_rewards: backing off on a loss and re-growing at a rate that neither idles the link nor starves neighbours
pressures.observable_consequence: throughput per flow, loss rate, convergence time between flows
pressures.vacuity_condition: a single sender on an uncontended link; or a link that never drops
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: send at a fixed low rate (safe, wastes the link); a world must reward utilisation AND punish loss
pressures.cheat_control: a sender that reads the bottleneck capacity directly from the world must reach the utilisation that the loss-signal-only sender can only approach; if it cannot, the world does not reward the capability
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: transmit a byte stream reliably

pressures.condition: the bottleneck buffer holds many seconds of data, so loss arrives long after queueing delay has grown; a loss-driven sender fills the buffer and every flow's latency rises
pressures.world_rewards: an estimate of the pipe (rate and floor delay) used instead of waiting for loss
pressures.observable_consequence: queueing delay under load; min_rtt drift
pressures.vacuity_condition: shallow buffers (loss and delay rise together)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed low rate; a sender that never probes for more
pressures.cheat_control: a sender given the true bandwidth and propagation delay must show low delay at full utilisation in the world; otherwise the world's reward is not measuring the capability

pressures.condition: a middlebox admits traffic at a fixed long-term rate and drops bursts above it; a sender that probes upward is punished with a burst of loss every probe
pressures.resource_or_constraint: an external rate cap invisible except through loss timing
pressures.failure_condition: repeated loss bursts each probe cycle; throughput well below the cap
pressures.world_rewards: inferring the cap from two agreeing loss-bounded intervals and holding at it
pressures.observable_consequence: loss rate vs sending rate shows a knee at the cap
pressures.vacuity_condition: no enforcer, or an enforcer with a bucket larger than the probe
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a sender that halves on every loss (Reno) finds a rate below the cap but oscillates; the world must reward holding AT the cap
pressures.cheat_control: a sender told the cap must hold it with near-zero loss; if the world does not distinguish that from the oscillating sender, the pressure is not being measured

pressures.source_evidence: tcp_bbr.c 816-870 comments; tcp_cubic.c 366-384 (the same problem patched in HyStart)
pressures.condition: the return path delivers acknowledgements in bursts (link-layer aggregation), so per-ACK rate and delay samples misrepresent the forward path and a window sized to the true BDP idles between bursts
pressures.failure_condition: underutilisation despite a correct rate estimate
pressures.world_punishes: a window with no allowance for feedback silence
pressures.world_rewards: estimating the excess acked beyond the expected and provisioning for it
pressures.observable_consequence: throughput gap that closes when cwnd is padded
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: an unbounded cwnd (fills buffers; punished by the bufferbloat pressure)
pressures.cheat_control: a sender with the aggregation size given must reach full throughput
